verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation on ClickUp's performance at scale or on task or item caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. Community comments about slow loading and high RAM use are general anecdotes, not scale benchmarks or documented limits, and there is no vendor claim for them to dispute. Performance and limits are a fair question for a project-tracking tool, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
